entries.basis: Complete article read on JSTOR 528416 (Open JSTOR, public domain), AJSL 34.2 (Jan. 1918): 137-139. Montgomery states that Rev. Professor H. Hyvernat of the Catholic University of America placed in his hands an incantation bowl in his possession with eleven lines of spiral inscription, then gives a transliteration and a translation (client Nuri daughter of Giloi). One bowl.
